name: known classification probabilities
test:
import math
import torch
x = torch.tensor([[0.,0.],[math.log(3),0.]], dtype=torch.float64)
y = torch.tensor([0,1])
loss = cross_entropy_loss(x,y)
assert isinstance(loss,torch.Tensor) and loss.shape == ()
torch.testing.assert_close(loss,x.new_tensor((math.log(2)+math.log(4))/2))

name: matches reference values and gradients
test:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
x = torch.randn(4,7,generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(31),dtype=torch.float64,requires_grad=True)
y = torch.tensor([6,0,4,2])
snapshot = x.detach().clone()
loss = cross_entropy_loss(x,y)
expected = F.cross_entropy(x,y)
torch.testing.assert_close(loss,expected)
got, = torch.autograd.grad(loss,x)
want, = torch.autograd.grad(expected,x)
torch.testing.assert_close(got,want)
assert torch.equal(x.detach(),snapshot)
print('ok')

name: stable for extreme logits and per-row shifts
test:
import math
import torch
x = torch.tensor([[10000.,-10000.],[-10000.,10000.],[9999.,9999.]],requires_grad=True)
y = torch.tensor([1,0,1])
loss = cross_entropy_loss(x,y)
assert torch.isfinite(loss)
torch.testing.assert_close(loss,x.new_tensor((40000.+math.log(2))/3))
loss.backward()
assert torch.isfinite(x.grad).all()
shifted = x.detach()+torch.tensor([[0.],[0.],[-9999.]])
torch.testing.assert_close(cross_entropy_loss(shifted,y),loss.detach())
print('ok')

name: masked token mean uses valid-token count
input: unequal response lengths and ignored -100 labels
test:
import math
import torch
x = torch.tensor([[[0.,0.],[0.,math.log(3)],[3.,-2.]],[[0.,math.log(7)],[1.,-1.],[4.,2.]]],dtype=torch.float64)
y = torch.tensor([[0,0,-100],[0,-100,-100]])
m = torch.tensor([[True,True,False],[True,False,False]])
snapshot = (x.clone(),y.clone(),m.clone())
loss = cross_entropy_loss(x,y,m)
torch.testing.assert_close(loss,x.new_tensor((math.log(2)+math.log(4)+math.log(8))/3))
for got,want in zip((x,y,m),snapshot): assert torch.equal(got,want)
print('ok')

name: excluded positions have zero gradients
input: masked batch with arbitrary padded logits
test:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
x = torch.randn(2,3,5,generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(7),dtype=torch.float64,requires_grad=True)
y = torch.tensor([[2,-100,4],[-100,1,-100]])
m = y != -100
loss = cross_entropy_loss(x,y,m)
expected = F.cross_entropy(x[m],y[m])
got, = torch.autograd.grad(loss,x)
want, = torch.autograd.grad(expected,x)
torch.testing.assert_close(loss,expected)
torch.testing.assert_close(got,want)
assert torch.equal(got[~m],torch.zeros_like(got[~m]))
print('ok')

name: singleton dimensions dtype and classification mask
test:
import torch
for dtype in (torch.float32,torch.float64):
 x = torch.tensor([[[4.]]],dtype=dtype,requires_grad=True)
 y = torch.tensor([[0]])
 loss = cross_entropy_loss(x,y)
 assert loss.shape == () and loss.dtype == dtype and loss.device == x.device
 torch.testing.assert_close(loss,x.new_tensor(0.))
 loss.backward()
 torch.testing.assert_close(x.grad,torch.zeros_like(x))
 x2 = torch.tensor([[0.,0.,0.],[1.,2.,3.]],dtype=dtype,requires_grad=True)
 y2 = torch.tensor([1,-100]); m = torch.tensor([True,False])
 loss2 = cross_entropy_loss(x2,y2,m)
 torch.testing.assert_close(loss2,x2.new_tensor(3.).log())
 assert loss2.dtype == dtype
print('ok')

name: noncontiguous inputs and all-true masks
input: class-last tensors with transposed leading axes
test:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
x = torch.randn(3,2,4,generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(17),dtype=torch.float64).transpose(0,1).requires_grad_()
y = torch.tensor([[0,1],[2,3],[1,0]]).transpose(0,1)
assert not x.is_contiguous() and not y.is_contiguous()
expected = F.cross_entropy(x.reshape(-1,4),y.reshape(-1))
for m in (None,torch.ones_like(y,dtype=torch.bool)):
 loss = cross_entropy_loss(x,y,m)
 torch.testing.assert_close(loss,expected)
print('ok')
